    None = 0x0,
    Acquire = 0x2,
    Release = 0x4,
    AcquireRelease = 0x8,
    SequentiallyConsistent = 0x10,
    UniformMemory = 0x40,
    SubgroupMemory = 0x80,
    WorkgroupMemory = 0x100,
    CrossWorkgroupMemory = 0x200,
    AtomicCounterMemory = 0x400,
    ImageMemory = 0x800,
  };
